packageRules.description: Workspace cloudflare-tokens plans every PR with the bootstrap token, which can mint any Cloudflare token (INFRA-133): no provider bump branch, and so no plan, until the owner ticks it on the dashboard.
Database majors are one-way data-dir upgrades: never proposed. Upgrade by hand after a fresh dump (clusters/platform/data/RESTORE.md).
App images (contract section 8): production references vX.Y.Z only. Track release tags, ignore sha- tags, no digest pin. Merging the bump PR is the deploy.

Staging follows releases (INFRA-36): bumps of manifests under a ziftbook-staging/ directory, majors included, merge without a PR once CI passes on the branch. Own branch prefix so a staging bump never shares a branch (and its automerge) with a production bump, which stays a PR. One group, so backend, frontend and migrations move together (a Renovate run while promote is retagging can still propose a partial set; the next run completes it).
TBD production (INFRA-43): backend, scheduler, migrations and frontend move together in one PR, so a merge never runs a schema/code skew. No automerge: the PR is the deploy gate.
